cases.name: valid (a): the reference
cases.sql:
-- Every trip stays, with NULL for a clean trip and the first failing rule otherwise.
WITH checked AS (
SELECT *, CASE WHEN fare_amount < 0 THEN 'negative_fare'
               WHEN dropoff_at < pickup_at THEN 'time_travel'
               WHEN pickup_at < TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' OR pickup_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01' THEN 'outside_january'
               WHEN trip_distance = 0 AND fare_amount >= 50 THEN 'zero_distance_high_fare'
          END AS reason
FROM trips
) SELECT * FROM checked;

cases.name: valid (b): UNION ALL of exclusive rules, clean trips as an anti-join
cases.sql:
WITH quarantine AS (
        SELECT *, 'negative_fare' AS reason FROM trips WHERE fare_amount < 0
        UNION ALL SELECT *, 'time_travel' FROM trips WHERE dropoff_at < pickup_at AND NOT fare_amount < 0
        UNION ALL SELECT *, 'outside_january' FROM trips WHERE (pickup_at < TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' OR pickup_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01') AND NOT fare_amount < 0 AND NOT dropoff_at < pickup_at
        UNION ALL SELECT *, 'zero_distance_high_fare' FROM trips WHERE trip_distance = 0 AND fare_amount >= 50 AND NOT fare_amount < 0 AND NOT dropoff_at < pickup_at AND NOT (pickup_at < TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' OR pickup_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01'))
        SELECT t.*, NULL::VARCHAR AS reason FROM trips t ANTI JOIN quarantine q ON q.row_id = t.row_id
        UNION ALL SELECT * FROM quarantine
